stages.title: SEVEN PADĀRTHAS

pills.text: EARTH, WATER, FIRE, AIR, ĀKĀŚA, TIME, SPACE, SELF, MIND
QUALITY; DEPENDS ON SUBSTANCE, DOES NOT ITSELF POSSESS QUALITY/ACTION

sequence: PADĀRTHA: whatever is nameable and knowable
1 DRAVYA: earth, water, fire, air, ākāśa, time, space, self, mind
2 GUṆA: quality; depends on substance, does not itself possess quality/action
3 KARMA: motion/action in a substance
4 SĀMĀNYA: real universal, one-in-many

LAYER 3 - ADVANCED Advanced unity and historical qualification Historically, Nyaya and Vaisesika begin as distinguishable schools rather

groups.heading: ADVANCED OBJECTION
items: than one undifferentiated doctrine.
Their later synthesis is a division of labour: Nyaya contributes pramana theory, inference and dialectic, while Vaisesika contributes
padarthas, atomism, visesa and samavaya.
Navya-Nyaya then sharpens the shared analytic vocabulary.

groups.heading: COMPARATIVE NUANCE
items: This system is realist in three linked senses.
Objects exist independently of cognition
valid cognition can disclose them
and even error is explained through misrelation among real factors rather than by reducing the world to appearance.
